pack.title: NIST AI Risk Management Framework
pack.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
pack.attribution: The four functions and nineteen categories of the framework, each summarized in a sentence. The subcategories are not included. Read the framework itself for its full text.

requirements.title: Govern
requirements.text: A culture of risk management is cultivated and present.

children.text: Policies, processes, and practices for mapping, measuring, and managing AI risks are in place, transparent, and carried out.
Accountability structures are in place so that the right people are empowered, responsible, and trained.
Workforce diversity, equity, inclusion, and accessibility are prioritized in managing AI risks.
Teams are committed to a culture that considers and communicates AI risk.
Processes are in place for robust engagement with those affected and other relevant parties.
Policies and procedures address risks and benefits from third-party software, data, and other supply chain issues.

requirements.title: Map
requirements.text: Context is recognized and risks related to context are identified.

children.text: Capabilities, targeted usage, goals, and expected benefits and costs are understood.
Risks and benefits are mapped for all components of the system, including third-party software and data.
Impacts to individuals, groups, communities, organizations, and society are characterized.

requirements.title: Measure
requirements.text: Identified risks are assessed, analyzed, or tracked.

children.text: Appropriate methods and metrics are identified and applied.
AI systems are evaluated for trustworthy characteristics.
Mechanisms for tracking identified AI risks over time are in place.
Feedback about the efficacy of measurement is gathered and assessed.

requirements.title: Manage
requirements.text: Risks are prioritized and acted upon based on a projected impact.

children.text: AI risks, based on assessments and other analysis, are prioritized, responded to, and managed.
Strategies to maximize benefits and minimize negative impacts are planned, prepared, carried out, and documented.
AI risks and benefits from third-party entities are managed.
Risk treatments, including response and recovery and communication plans, are documented and monitored regularly.
